channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: ElevenLabs in early talks for 2027 funding round at $33B target valuation, ARR at $700M
item.description: ElevenLabs is in early talks for a 2027 funding round at a $33 billion valuation, up from $22 billion in September, with annual recurring revenue now at $700 million.

item.title: UK NCSC warns of marked rise in AI-assisted cyberattacks from agentic offensive frameworks
item.description: The UK's cyber agency warns AI-assisted attacks have risen sharply since September, as agentic frameworks let attackers probe and exploit known weaknesses within minutes.

item.title: Bedrock Data's Agent DLP now infers intent and evaluates agent behavior to stop sensitive data exposure
item.description: Bedrock Data's Agent DLP now judges AI agents by their intent and behavior, blocking risky data exposure while letting authorized work continue.

item.title: Every raises $17.5M Series A at $110M valuation to make teams AI-native
item.description: Every raised $17.5 million at a $110 million valuation to build one subscription that helps people and teams work with AI, led by IA Ventures.

item.title: Saudi AI startup 009 raises $1.4M pre-seed to build agents for government and industry
item.description: Riyadh AI startup 009 raised $1.4 million to build AI agents that automate administrative work for government agencies and industrial companies.

item.title: Anthropic ships Skills over MCP in public beta; MCP Tasks and Elicitation reach general availability
item.description: Anthropic's MCP now lets servers ship skills alongside tools, run long jobs in the background, and pause to ask a human before risky actions.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, a $3/$15 mid-tier frontier model
item.description: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a mid-tier frontier model priced at $3 per million input tokens with a 1-million-token context window.

item.description: WhatsApp's Direct Send lets businesses send utility and one-time-code messages without creating a template first.
